subject: Acme Health demo — qualification & scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — quick qualification questions

Hi Sophie,

Thanks for signing up and requesting a demo — really appreciate the interest. I work on SDR at Redwood Inference and I’d like to ask a few quick questions so we can tailor the demo to Acme Health’s needs and make the time most productive. Would you mind replying with short answers to the bullets below?

- What is the primary use case you’re evaluating (search/triage/clinical QA/summary/embeddings)?
- Approximate monthly volume (incoming docs / calls / tokens per month) you expect during pilot and production?
- Timeline: are you looking to pilot in the next 30/90/180 days?
- Any data sensitivity/regulatory constraints (PHI/HIPAA) we should be aware of?

If it’s easier to pick a time, here are some slots I have next week: Mon 3/30 10:00–10:30 PT, Tue 3/31 11:00–11:30 PT, Wed 4/1 14:00–14:30 PT — or you can pick on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

Also looping in Rishi (cc’d) — he’ll be on the demo if technical questions or pricing come up.

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health IT <it@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — quick qualification questions

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers below: 

- Use case: semantic search + embedding-based patient note retrieval for clinical support teams; looking to improve provider search time and reduce duplicate work.
- Volume: pilot will start small (~100k–200k notes / month, roughly 500k–1M tokens/month). If pilot goes well, we expect ~2–3M tokens/month within 6–9 months.
- Timeline: hoping to kick off a pilot in ~60 days (May).
- Data sensitivity: yes, this will include PHI; HIPAA-compliant hosting and audit logs are required.

Available for demo next week Tue (3/31) morning PT — 11:00 works. I attached a short requirements doc with our security checklist.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Turner
Product Manager, Search & Clinical Tools
Acme Health
sophie.turner@acmehealth.com

Thanks again — looking forward to it.
